# Atlantia STEM Olympiads — Kazakhstan

> International subject olympiads (Atlantia Science Olympiads) in mathematics, physics, informatics, chemistry and biology for school students in grades 3–11(12) in Kazakhstan. National round 2026–2027 held in person in cities across Kazakhstan (October 2026 – March 2027), World Final in Turkey (January 2027) or Spain (May 2027) for participants scoring more than 50%. Fee: 25 000 KZT per subject, paid via Kaspi. Official representative in Kazakhstan: AZ GROUP LLC (Astana); co-organiser: "Astana Daryny". Site languages: Russian, Kazakh, English.

## Pages

- [Home / registration / FAQ](https://atlantia-olympiads.kz/): subjects, stages, format, prizes, fee calculator, FAQ, consultation form
- [Regulations 2026–2027 (Положение)](https://atlantia-olympiads.kz/polozhenie): official rules in Russian and Kazakh, PDF downloads
- [Public offer (Публичная оферта)](https://atlantia-olympiads.kz/oferta): participation terms, payment and refund rules
